Izzy: Heads up — on the latency dashboard /v1/chat in na had p99(40ms) < p95(120ms) for last 15m. Looks impossible.
Carlos: Any recent quota or routing tweaks?
Izzy: We tightened per-tenant quota 20m ago and enabled a cheap-fallback route for throttled requests. Telemetry shows lots of fast responses from fallback.
Maggie: That would explain it: throttled requests redirected to a microfast path with low latencies. If rollups merge by raw sampled counts and the sampler amplifies fallback events, the global p99 can drop below p95.
Carlos: Quick check query I ran: ```SELECT sample_origin, count(*) n, percentile(response_ms,0.99) p99, percentile(response_ms,0.95) p95 FROM requests WHERE endpoint='/v1/chat' AND ts>now()-15m GROUP BY sample_origin;``` Fallback p99=8 p95=6, primary p99=240 p95=130, merged shows p99=40 p95=120.
Izzy: Short-term console change: annotate latency charts with "quota-routing in effect" and show per-origin percentiles in the legend.
Maggie: Medium-term telemetry fix: carry `effective_count` per origin and do weight-aware merges or compute percentiles from weighted histogram. Also add a unit test in the aggregator simulating quota->fallback traffic.
Carlos: Also add an alert rule: if merged_p99 < merged_p95 OR if merged_p95 deviates >50ms from median of origin p95s then flag and attach per-origin breakdown link.
OpsBot: Created ticket INC-2026-058: "quota-fallback-percentile-inversion". Tasks: console-annotation, aggregator-weighted-merge, alert-rule. https://redwood/internal/inc/INC-2026-058
Izzy: I'll open the console PR for the annotation and per-origin legend. Maggie you take the aggregator PR?
Maggie: Yep — github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/4499. Will include test harness and runbook SQL.
Carlos: Good. Add eng-sre and eng-runtime to the incident so future quota rollouts run the smokecheck.
Izzy: Thanks — putting a quick dashboard panel that compares merged vs weighted percentiles behind a feature flag now.
